path_diff.meaning: proves fork-relative path delta only; does not prove exclusive authorship

commit_lineage.method: git log <pinned-baseline>..HEAD -- <changed-path> with commit author, merge and declared co-author trailer signals
commit_lineage.meaning: reduces origin uncertainty by recording observed path-touch history; commit metadata is not hunk authorship, originality, copyright ownership, or license entitlement

closed_controls: identify and pin parent-fork baseline commit
produce deterministic path-level diff against baseline
bind upstream COPYING to exact Git blob
separate fork delta from authorship claim
record bounded per-path commit lineage and declared AI co-author signals without promoting ownership
required_closure: classify changed hunks by origin where an authorship/license claim is intended
complete nested submodule, vendored-code and dependency governing-term reconciliation
preserve all applicable upstream and third-party notices
record AI-assisted/generated provenance where known beyond commit metadata
only then decide whether any compatible authorial notice is appropriate

examples: additional embedded BSD-style notices in frida-gum COPYING

main_branch_protection.meaning: workflow success is evidence, but is not mandatory merge policy until GitHub branch/ruleset configuration proves enforcement

gates.falsifier: COPYING missing or Git blob differs from pinned manifest blob
pinned baseline commit is absent or is not an ancestor of HEAD
deterministic baseline-to-HEAD path inventory cannot be generated
per-path commit metadata ledger cannot be regenerated from the pinned baseline and current HEAD
.gitmodules path/URL, HEAD gitlink or conservative first-level registry binding drifts; compatibility may not be promoted by this gate
ownership is promoted from path-delta or commit-lineage evidence without hunk-origin evidence
first-level unresolved license source, nested submodule, vendored or dependency material lacks reconciled governing terms or compatibility proof
GitHub branch/ruleset API does not show main protected with intended required checks

risk.primary: accidental ownership or license claim over upstream, AI-assisted, generated, mixed-origin, or third-party material
mitigations: COPYING remains unmodified authority for its scope and is blob-pinned
every path changed since the pinned baseline is inventoried automatically
bounded per-path commit lineage is recorded with author/merge/co-author signals
commit metadata is explicitly not treated as hunk authorship or copyright ownership
path delta is explicitly not treated as exclusive authorship evidence
all first-level submodule gitlinks and URLs are bound to a conservative registry
distinct first-level license-source observations are preserved instead of flattened
the unresolved releng root license source remains TOKEN_VAZIO
nested submodule, vendored and dependency reconciliation remains TOKEN_VAZIO
runtime and security claims remain separate from source presence
workflow success is not represented as mandatory merge enforcement while main remains unprotected

rollback.procedure: revert only the provenance hardening commits; upstream source and COPYING remain untouched
